free_tier.stated: no free tier; all services are invoiced monthly on a usage-based unit system, and a credit card is set up during account creation
free_tier.notes: unverified: a public price list at constellix.com/pricing/faq answered HTTP 503 on 2026-11-19; the unit billing model is from the first-party billing article

per_object_cap.stated: no per-record or per-zone object cap stated on the first-party pages read; quotas exist for particular services but their values are unverified: behind a sign-up and not published
per_object_cap.notes: the billing page confirms quotas exist but gives no numbers

retention.stated: records persist while the service is configured; deleting the configured service stops billing, and a card validity fee and monthly invoicing apply

egress.terms: DNS queries are billed by usage count; each count is an allotment of one million queries, and standard queries use a pricing schedule that lowers the unit cost above one billion queries

interface_detail: a REST API for domains and DNS records; API v4 docs at api.dns.constellix.com/v4/docs. Client libraries include DNSControl, the Constellix Terraform provider and the lego ACME DNS plugin
tooling: DNSControl, the Constellix Terraform provider, lego ACME client, any client that can sign HMAC calls with an API key and secret key
chaining: an authoritative DNS service with GeoDNS, traffic steering, DNS failover and IP Filter routing, now a DigiCert brand; there is no free tier and a card is required, so a free hosted DNS service is the path for a no-cost stack

limits.value: per-service quotas exist to prevent abuse; their numeric values are unverified: quoted nowhere on the first-party pages read
a payment method must be set up before services can be accessed; a card validity fee of USD 5 is processed at setup
all accounts are given a USD 100 credit limit threshold by default; usage above it triggers automatic invoicing

binding_note: there is no free tier and access to services requires a payment method on file, so the card gate binds before any usage quota or query cost is reached

identity_cost.detail: By default, all payments within Constellix are made via credit card; setting up a credit card during account setup processes a USD 5 returnable validity fee, and services stay inaccessible until payment details are set up. Email is also required for an account, but the card is the gate that decides access. No free tier is published; the exact signup fields beyond the card are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: a 100 percent uptime SLA is offered; no suspension, throttle or data-loss event was found on the pages read
confidence_note: the first-party billing article, API docs and DigiCert brand page were captured and quoted. The pricing page at constellix.com/pricing/faq answered HTTP 503 on 2026-11-19, so per-unit prices remain unverified; the billing model and card gate are first-party.
